senses.gloss: f., pl. טִירָאוֹת (v. טִירָה) places for augury, (templum).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite> (play on <he>מטרד</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 36:39">Gen. XXXVI, 39</cite>) <he>שהיו מעמידין טיראות וכ׳</he> ‘Rashi’ (in ed. Wil. 1878; text <cite ref="I00230"><he>טוּרָיוֹת</he></cite>) they put up auguries for idolatry, v. <cite ref="I00214"><he>טוּר</he> I</cite>; Yalk. ib. 140 <cite ref="I00443"><he>טיריון</he></cite> (read: <cite ref="I00444"><he>טִירָיוֹת</he></cite>.).
